explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the HTML fragment in body context, then walked tokens with `next_token()` and collected ordinary `#text` nodes plus decoded text from `TITLE` and `TEXTAREA` opener tokens via `get_modifiable_text()`. After concatenation, I truncated by Unicode code points with `mb_strlen()`/`mb_substr()` and returned an empty string for nonpositive limits.
